readings.section: Book V: Psalms of Thanksgiving and History
readings.title: The Redeemed from the Adversary
readings.subtitle: His everlasting loving-commitment reclaims the scattered from every direction.
readings.text: [Psalm 107:1] Give thanks to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>! For <dn>He</dn> is good, For <dn>His</dn> loving-commitment is everlasting. [2] Let the redeemed of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> say so, Whom <dn>He</dn> has redeemed from the hand of the adversary, [3] And gathered out of the lands, From east and from west, From north and from south.

readings.section: Book V: Psalms of Thanksgiving and History
readings.title: Restoration of the Wanderers
readings.subtitle: He intervenes in the desolate places to satisfy the longing and hungry.
readings.text: [Psalm 107:4] They wandered in a wilderness, in a desert way; They found no city to dwell in. [5] Hungry and thirsty, Their being in them grew faint. [6] Then they cried out to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> in their distress, <dn>He</dn> delivered them out of their troubles. [7] And <dn>He</dn> guided them by the right way, To go to a city to settle. [8] Let them give thanks to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> for <dn>His</dn> loving-commitment, And <dn>His</dn> wonders to the children of men! [9] For <dn>He</dn> has satisfied a longing being, And has filled the hungry being with goodness.

readings.section: Book V: Psalms of Thanksgiving and History
readings.title: Dismantling the Penal Affliction
readings.subtitle: Rebelling against His instruction brings bondage, but His intervention shatters the iron chains.
readings.text: [Psalm 107:10] Some sat in darkness and in the shadow of death, Bound in affliction and irons, [11] Because they rebelled against the words of <dn>Ěl</dn>, And despised the counsel of the Most High. [12] And <dn>He</dn> humbled their heart by toil; They stumbled, and there was no one to help. [13] And they cried out to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> in their distress, And <dn>He</dn> saved them out of their troubles. [14] <dn>He</dn> brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, And <dn>He</dn> broke their chains in pieces. [15] Let them give thanks to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> for <dn>His</dn> loving-commitment, And <dn>His</dn> wonders to the children of men! [16] For <dn>He</dn> has broken the gates of bronze, And <dn>He</dn> cut the bars of iron in two.

readings.section: Book V: Psalms of Thanksgiving and History
readings.title: The Word Sent to Heal
readings.subtitle: He rescues the afflicted from the gates of death by sending His healing instruction.
readings.text: [Psalm 107:17] Fools, because of their transgression, And because of their crookednesses, were afflicted. [18] Their being loathed all food, And they drew near to the gates of death, [19] And cried out to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> in their distress, <dn>He</dn> saved them out of their troubles. [20] <dn>He</dn> sent <dn>His</dn> word and healed them, And delivered them from their destructions. [21] Let them give thanks to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> for <dn>His</dn> loving-commitment, And <dn>His</dn> wonders to the children of men! [22] And let them slaughter slaughterings of thanksgiving, And relate <dn>His</dn> works with rejoicing.

readings.section: Book V: Psalms of Thanksgiving and History
readings.title: Commanding the Storms
readings.subtitle: The Creator dictates the chaotic waters, leading the storm-tossed to a secure haven.
readings.text: [Psalm 107:23] Those who go down to the sea in ships, Doing work in many waters, [24] They see the works of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, And <dn>His</dn> wonders in the deep. [25] For <dn>He</dn> commands and raises the stormy wind, Which lifts up the waves of the sea. [26] They go up to the heavens, They go down to the depths; Their being is melted because of evil. [27] They celebrate and stagger like a drunkard, And all their wisdom is swallowed up. [28] Then they cry out to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> in their distress, And <dn>He</dn> brings them out of their troubles. [29] <dn>He</dn> caused the storm to be still, So that its waves were silent. [30] And they rejoice because they are hushed; And <dn>He</dn> leads them to the haven of their delight. [31] Let them give thanks to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> for <dn>His</dn> loving-commitment, And <dn>His</dn> wonders to the children of men! [32] And let them exalt <dn>Him</dn> in the assembly of the people, And praise <dn>Him</dn> in the seat of the elders.

readings.section: Book V: Psalms of Thanksgiving and History
readings.title: The Absolute Control of Terrestrial Resources
readings.subtitle: He alters the geophysical landscape to execute justice and provide absolute surplus.
readings.text: [Psalm 107:33] <dn>He</dn> makes rivers become a wilderness, And the fountains of water become a dry ground; [34] A land of fruit becomes a salty desert, For the evil of those who dwell in it. [35] <dn>He</dn> makes a wilderness become a pool of water, And dry land become fountains of waters. [36] And <dn>He</dn> causes the hungry to dwell there, And they build a city to settle in, [37] And they sow fields and plant vineyards, And they make fruits of increase. [38] And <dn>He</dn> blesses them, And they increase greatly; And <dn>He</dn> lets not their cattle diminish.

readings.section: Book V: Psalms of Thanksgiving and History
readings.title: Reversing the Power Structures
readings.subtitle: The wise observe how He dismantles corrupt nobles and elevates the straight.
readings.text: [Psalm 107:39] But when they are diminished and brought low Through oppression, evil and sorrow, [40] <dn>He</dn> pours scorn on nobles, And causes them to wander in a pathless waste; [41] But <dn>He</dn> raises the poor up from affliction, And makes their clans like a flock. [42] The straight ones see, and rejoice, And all unrighteousness shuts its mouth. [43] Who is wise? Then let him observe these matters! Let them understand the loving-commitments of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.

readings.section: Book V: Psalms of Thanksgiving and History
readings.title: The Geometry of Divine Works
readings.subtitle: A perfect sequence of praise acknowledging His unshakeable covenant and precise right-ruling.
readings.text: [Psalm 111:1] Aleph Praise <dn>Yah</dn>! I thank <dn>את</dn> <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> with all my heart, Bět In the company of the straight, and of the congregation. [2] Gimel Great are the works of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, Dalet Searched for by all who delight in them. [3] Hě Splendour and greatness are <dn>His</dn> work, Waw And <dn>His</dn> righteousness stands forever. [4] Zayin <dn>He</dn> has made <dn>His</dn> wonders to be remembered; Ḥet <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> shows favour and is compassionate. [5] Tet <dn>He</dn> has given food to those who fear <dn>Him</dn>; Yod <dn>He</dn> remembers <dn>His</dn> covenant forever. [6] Kaph <dn>He</dn> has shown <dn>His</dn> people the power of <dn>His</dn> works, Lamed To give to them the inheritance of the nations. [7] Mem The works of <dn>His</dn> hands are truth and right-ruling, Nun All <dn>His</dn> orders are trustworthy, [8] Sameḵ They are upheld forever and ever, Ayin Performed in truth and straightness. [9] Pě <dn>He</dn> sent redemption to <dn>His</dn> people, Tsadi <dn>He</dn> has commanded <dn>His</dn> covenant forever. Qoph Set-apart and awesome is <dn>His</dn> Name. [10] Rěsh The fear of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is the beginning of wisdom, Shin All those doing them have a good understanding. Tav <dn>His</dn> praise is standing forever.

readings.section: Book V: Psalms of Thanksgiving and History
readings.title: The Profile of the Righteous
readings.subtitle: The man who operates within His laws builds wealth, stability, and enduring trust.
readings.text: [Psalm 112:1] Aleph Praise <dn>Yah</dn>! Blessed is the man, Who fears <dn>את</dn> <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, Bět Who has greatly delighted in <dn>His</dn> commands. [2] Gimel Mighty in the earth shall be his seed, Dalet The generation of the straight ones shall be blessed. [3] Hě Wealth and riches are in his house, Waw And his righteousness is standing forever. [4] Zayin Light has risen in the darkness to the straight ones, Those showing favour, Ḥet The compassionate, And the righteous. [5] Tet Good is a man showing favour and lending, Yod He sustains his matters in right-ruling. [6] Kaph For he is never shaken; Lamed The righteous is remembered forever. [7] Mem He is not afraid of an evil report. Nun His heart is steadfast, trusting in <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. [8] Sameḵ His heart is upheld, he is not afraid, Ayin While he looks on his adversaries. [9] Pě He scattered abroad, He gave to the poor, Tsadi His righteousness is standing forever. Qoph His horn is exalted with esteem. [10] Rěsh The wrong one sees it and shall be vexed; Shin He gnashes his teeth and shall melt. Tav The desire of the wrong ones does perish.

readings.section: Book V: Psalms of Thanksgiving and History
readings.title: Exalting the Singular Name
readings.subtitle: From sunrise to sunset, the authority and reputation of the Creator stand above all earthly powers.
readings.text: [Psalm 113:1] Praise <dn>Yah</dn>! Praise, O servants of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, Praise <dn>את</dn> the Name of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>! [2] Blessed be the Name of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, Now and forever! [3] From the rising of the sun to its going down, The Name of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is praised. [4] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is high above all nations, <dn>His</dn> esteem above the heavens.

readings.section: Book V: Psalms of Thanksgiving and History
readings.title: The Great Reversal of Status
readings.subtitle: He intervenes directly into physical reality to establish the destitute and the barren.
readings.text: [Psalm 113:5] Who is like <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> our <dn>Elohim</dn>, Who is enthroned on high? [6] <dn>He</dn> looks down on the heavens and in the earth; [7] <dn>He</dn> raises the poor out of the dust, Lifts the needy from a dunghill, [8] To make him sit with the nobles, With the nobles of <dn>His</dn> people, [9] Causing the barren woman to dwell in a house, A rejoicing mother of children. Praise <dn>Yah</dn>!

readings.section: Book V: Psalms of Thanksgiving and History
readings.title: The Crucible of Mitsrayim Escaped
readings.subtitle: Physical creation reacts violently to the localized presence of the Master.
readings.text: [Psalm 114:1] When Yisra’ěl went out of Mitsrayim, The house of Yaʽaqoḇ from a people of strange language, [2] Yehuḏah became <dn>His</dn> set-apart place, And Yisra’ěl <dn>His</dn> rule. [3] The sea saw it and fled; The Yarděn turned back. [4] The mountains skipped like rams, The little hills like lambs.

readings.section: Book V: Psalms of Thanksgiving and History
readings.title: Nature Trembles Before the Architect
readings.subtitle: The physical earth must recognize and obey the functional authority of the Creator.
readings.text: [Psalm 114:5] Why was it, O sea, that you fled? O Yarděn, that you turned back? [6] O mountains, that you skipped like rams? O little hills, like lambs? [7] Tremble, O earth, from the face of the <dn>Master</dn>, From the face of the <dn>Eloah</dn> of Yaʽaqoḇ, [8] Who turned the rock into a pool of water, The flint into a fountain of water.
